name: NutrientManagementPlanner
tagline: Plan fertiliser and manure by field, check NVZ limits and closed periods, and record what was spread.
description: A complete nutrient management planning app for Power Apps and Power Pages: crop N, P2O5 and K2O requirement against planned and applied nutrients, soil indices, organic manure N with crop-available N, N max per crop, field and farm organic N limits, closed periods, approval workflow and an application log. Works with demo data the moment it is dropped on a screen.
features: Product library calculator (manufactured % or organic kg per t/m3 with available N %)
Requirement vs planned vs applied bars for N, P2O5 and K2O
N max per crop and field/farm organic N limits with override reasons
Closed periods by product type (hard block)
Draft - Planned - Approved - Applied workflow with undo
Bulk approve, record as applied, reschedule and cancel
CSV export and compliance summary to Power Fx
controlType: standard (2 controls: dataset NutrientManagementPlanner + Power Pages NutrientManagementPlannerPortal, shared src/app)
